reason: A DSH Web UI plugin and skin suite whose primary user-facing purpose is extending the interface with themes, panels, visualizations, mobile access, and related workflow tools; the README also documents SSH operations, scheduled execution, remote pairing, and external image-analysis integration.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web UI 提供可插拔的主题皮肤、任务看板、Git 图谱、侧边面板、移动端远程访问及 SSH 等扩展功能。
summaries.en: Extends the DeepSeek Harness Web UI with pluggable skins, task boards, Git graphs, side panels, mobile remote access, SSH tools, and related interface features.

capabilities: Adds configurable DSH Web UI plugins and skins
Provides task boards with scheduled agent task execution
Displays Git branch and commit visualizations
Provides remote mobile and browser pairing with synchronized workspace access
Provides SSH terminal, SFTP transfer, port forwarding, and multi-host command execution
Sends image references to configured OpenAI-compatible vision endpoints for analysis
Loads local wallpaper and skin assets
